mapper.sql: defense_id, user_id, cause_code, unavailable_start_date, expected_return_date, return_date, reserve_amount_snapshot, safe_asset_amount_snapshot, available_assets_snapshot, average_monthly_expense, daily_expense, d_day, calculation_status, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM DEFENSE_MODE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY defense_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM DEFENSE_MODE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'SCHEDULED') ORDER BY CASE WHEN status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, defense_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM DEFENSE_MODE WHERE status = 'SCHEDULED' AND unavailable_start_date <= #{today} ORDER BY unavailable_start_date ASC, defense_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DEFENSE_MODE ( user_id, cause_code, unavailable_start_date, expected_return_date, reserve_amount_snapshot, safe_asset_amount_snapshot, available_assets_snapshot, average_monthly_expense, daily_expense, d_day, calculation_status, status ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{causeCode}, #{unavailableStartDate}, #{expectedReturnDate}, #{reserveAmountSnapshot}, #{safeAssetAmountSnapshot}, #{availableAssetsSnapshot}, #{averageMonthlyExpense}, #{dailyExpense}, #{dDay}, #{calculationStatus}, #{status} )
mapper.update: UPDATE DEFENSE_MODE SET reserve_amount_snapshot = #{reserveAmountSnapshot}, safe_asset_amount_snapshot = #{safeAssetAmountSnapshot}, available_assets_snapshot = #{availableAssetsSnapshot}, average_monthly_expense = #{averageMonthlyExpense}, daily_expense = #{dailyExpense}, d_day = #{dDay}, calculation_status = #{calculationStatus}, status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE defense_id = #{defenseId} AND status = 'SCHEDULED'
